title: ?author= filter never works over real HTTP (wrap-params middleware missing)
evidence: src/book_api/core.clj:16,22 destructures :query-params and reads (get query-params "author"), but the middleware chain at core.clj:46-47 applies only wrap-json-body + wrap-json-response. Ring populates :query-params solely via ring.middleware.params/wrap-params (wrap-query-params), which is never required or applied (grep over src/test confirms no wrap-params). Over real HTTP via jetty (core.clj:52) query-params=nil, so db/list-books gets author=nil and returns ALL books. The db filter itself (db/db.clj:12-15) is correct but unreachable. test/book_api/core_test.clj:24 masks the gap by injecting :query-params directly into the request map, bypassing the HTTP layer.
suggestion: Add (:require [ring.middleware.params :refer [wrap-params]]) and insert wrap-params (or wrap-query-params) into the threading chain in app, and add a test that drives the filter through the raw :query-string rather than pre-parsed :query-params.
